_comment: LLM-adjudicated parent-child technology relationships. These are NOT aliases: the child is a distinct product or component under the parent umbrella. Scoring: a provider reporting any child counts as having found the parent; reporting the parent never grants a child. cruft_suspects are bare vendor umbrellas (claims true of nearly every company) that receive no rollup credit.

notes.react-native: Distinct technology from react in most buyer contexts; umbrella credit is debatable.
notes.azure-databricks: Also conceptually a child of databricks; multi-parent case, single parent kept.
notes.ambiguity_refusals: NOT merged (name collisions): compose (docker vs jetpack), vault (hashicorp vs azure-key-vault), aurora (amazon vs apache), blueprint, catalyst, canvas, delta (delta-lake vs airline), vertex (vertex-ai vs vertex tax), zephyr (rtos vs test tool), agility, active-directory vs azure-active-directory, composer vs visual-composer (php vs wpbakery), tower vs aws-control-tower, access vs ms-access, pub-html5 vs html5, sutra-tools plugin vs google-sheets.
